reviews.review: after 900 hours im convinced this is a dating sim

Cringe, the game: 

Overall a good game but it has shortcomings. 

The good: 
-Great movement set and combat system 
-relatively deep customization/build options 
-large enemy variety
-large mission variety 
-runs exceptionally well. Smooth as silk. 
-monetization is acceptable. No pay to win but pay to shortcut some grind. 
-lots of map tiles

The bad: 
-map design is horrible. Get stuck on little things everywhere. The movement system is held back by map design a great deal. 
-some of the systems are convoluted and unneccessarily complex without adding much to the experience or in ways of player choice. 
-some modes are half baked. Archwing and railjack feel tagged on and aren't as polished. We could have done without them. 
-unskipable cutscenes (!) 
-bad voiceacting and bad sound design in places. 
-mediocre writing throughout with dips into the abysmal 
-cheap voiceactors
-janky, unfun bossbattles 
-features countless recources and currencies (well over a hundred) which most have only one or two uses. It makes a convoluted impression with a lot of redundancy. What am i collecting all these useless recources for that i can't sell or exchange? 
It goes as far as featuring useless items to craft and in the marketplace like antitoxins which had their use removed but the approximately 15 associated items remain in the game with no purpose for 4 years and counting. 
-no kick option during games. So being griefed and trolled by randoms is something you will have to deal with on occasion. This is the first ever online multiplayer game i run into that has no kick option. What are they thinking? 

Despite its glaring design flaws it's still overall a decent game, though with lots of content and one of the better combat and movement systems out there. For the price of "free" it's certainly ok. 


8/10
